# What the Curve Is For

<!-- STEP id="assumption" -->
Every point on the curve assumes nothing is idle. If one strip lies empty this season, the farm grows less, and its point drops inside the curve.

<!-- STEP id="planning" -->
Farmers, enterprises and governments use curves like this to see the most their resources can produce.

**On the curve: all resources used. Inside: some resources wasted. Outside: not possible with the resources we have now.**
